responsibility: Implements the -Wmisleading-indentation warning by reconstructing visual indentation from source lines, tabs, and token locations and comparing guard/body/following-statement alignment. It contains the source-column analysis, heuristics for suppressing false positives around generated code or intervening preprocessing structure, and the final warning emission used by C-family parsers when they detect potentially misleading one-statement control-flow formatting.
same_name_distinction: Implementation of misleading-indentation analysis: it reads source lines, computes visual columns with tab handling, applies warning heuristics, and emits diagnostics, whereas c-indentation.h only defines the token_indent_info abstraction and declares the warning entry points.
